findings: No detector can stand in for the classifier. Of 135 pages the classifier finds notation on 98 (86 mixed, 12 tab); only 37 are prose, so skipping can save at most 27% of the calls.
PP-DocLayoutV3 never misses a notation page but saves only 5%: it also finds a region on 30 of the 37 prose pages — illustrations, ornaments, a headstock in the margin.
Ignoring small regions (under 3% of the page) saves 30% but misses 14 notation pages — mostly chord diagrams and short examples printed small. A missed page is an exercise never read.
The tag rules on PP-OCR text save 37% and miss 30 pages; V3 (no icons) or the rules together save 14% and still miss 7. CDLA saves 4% and misses 1.
Keep classifying every scanned page. The classifier costs ~$0.007 a page; what layout masking is for is clean OCR text (§12), not gating the parse.

Found on the way: a classifier reply looped (》》》…) to max_tokens on one page; messages.parse raised on the broken JSON before structured_call could check stop_reason, which in the parse would fail the whole chapter. It passed on retry. Calibration §13.
findings_zh: 没有一种检测方法能替掉分类器。135 页里分类器认为 98 页有谱子（86 页混排、12 页 tab），只有 37 页是纯文字，所以就算全对也最多省 27% 的调用。
PP-DocLayoutV3 一页谱子都不漏，但只能省 5%：37 页纯文字页里有 30 页它也框出了图片——插图、花边、页角的吉他头。
忽略小于页面 3% 的区域能省 30%，但漏掉 14 页有谱子的页，多是印得很小的和弦图和短谱例。漏一页就是一个练习永远读不出来。
正则规则省 37% 但漏 30 页；V3（忽略小图）加正则一起用，省 14% 仍漏 7 页；CDLA 省 4% 漏 1 页。
结论：每张扫描页都继续分类。分类每页约 $0.007；版面遮挡的价值是让 OCR 文字干净（§12），不是用来跳过分类。
顺带发现：有一页分类器的回复陷入重复（》》》…）直到 max_tokens，JSON 被截断，messages.parse 在 structured_call 检查 stop_reason 之前就抛了异常——在真实解析里这会让整章失败。重试后通过。详见 calibration §13。
